title: Landscaping Visit Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Commercial Landscaping Visit: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Landscaping Visit Inspection Checklist covers grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task. The grounds service coordinator records Commercial Landscaping Visit criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Landscaping Visit Inspection Checklist keeps Commercial Landscaping Visit exceptions visible until the grounds service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Landscaping Visit Inspection Checklist at property zone, bed, lawn area, slope, walkway, and equipment access route. Document grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task identity before Commercial Landscaping Visit begins. Compare grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task findings with stated Commercial Landscaping Visit criteria; route unresolved Commercial Landscaping Visit issues to landscape operations supervisor.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Commercial Landscaping Visit, identify responsible parties, property zone, bed, lawn area, slope, walkway, and equipment access route, and the linked grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task source.

fields.label: Zone, plant, irrigation, or task identifier
Approved seasonal scope and visit number

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Commercial Landscaping Visit facts for grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Commercial Landscaping Visit inspection checks
items: Turf, bed, tree, shrub, and plant-health condition
Irrigation coverage, leak, runoff, and controller observation
Walkway, curb, visibility, and access impact
Weed, debris, erosion, and drainage condition
Weather, soil moisture, and seasonal constraint
Completed quantity compared with contracted scope

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Before closing Commercial Landscaping Visit, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Grounds Service Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe tree, slope, equipment, or pedestrian condition
Weather prevents safe or effective work
Irrigation leak or runoff requires separate authority
blocks.guidance: Pause Commercial Landscaping Visit when a public-access hazard, weather stop, chemical boundary, or uncontrolled property condition remains. Retain the available Commercial Landscaping Visit proof and route unresolved grounds zone, plant material, irrigation interface, hardscape edge, and assigned task scope to grounds service coordinator.
